bot.name: BananaBrain
bot.description: AIIDE 2025 Protoss bot using human-opponent opening selection and persistent opponent results. Experimental local practice; human difficulty uncalibrated.

formats.notes: Protoss local practice tested on Fighting Spirit 1.4.

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the experimental bridge.

learning.notes: Original pretraining preserved; validated opponent results and mining data persist, preferring saved output over stale read inputs. Reset requires an idle profile and clearing read/write while preserving AI assets.

license.name: BananaBrain License
license.notes: Includes a written-author-permission condition for public StarCraft tournaments. Separate original BWEM notice and LGPLv3 BWAPI notice included.

localDistribution.evidence: New human-opponent runtime remains a review-only experimental candidate pending exact-package and gameplay review. Original license and public-tournament permission condition remain unchanged. docs/releases/bananabrain-sb-6.md

publicCompetition.evidence: Written author permission required for public StarCraft tournament entry; not recorded.

limitations: Assigned Protoss, experimental local 1v1 only; random/Terran/Zerg assignments, teams/FFA and x86 StarCraft remain unverified.
Human-opponent mode changes opening selection to UCB1 and enables original glhf/gg chat. Historical sb.5 matches do not verify this new runtime.
Requires compatible ShieldBattery native bridge, accurate gathered-resource reporting, supervised local practice and separate writable profiles.
Fresh package/gameplay review and upstream hosting of exact source-import commit remain required. Human difficulty and public competition are unreviewed.
Shared-profile writers, physical disk exhaustion and exhaustive OS tracing are outside reviewed scope.

sourceReview.evidence: Human-opponent configuration and corrected source inventory require current-package validation. Historical sb.5 evidence applies only to its recorded inputs. docs/releases/bananabrain-sb-6.md
